pool: 55 unique MSI features with prior reasonable-host LC candidate annotations; LC abundance never loaded
association: On training 10x10 ROIs: all specimen-pair rank AUCs; choose target class and high/low direction with greatest WORST pair AUC; require worst AUC>=0.75 and smallest signed specimen mean log2 gap>=0.25
shortlist: All eligible features; ranking for reporting only, no top-N truncation
search: Exhaustive search of every five-feature subset among all features passing the training-set association screen; no feature-identity exclusion, mutual-exclusion rule, or m/z-composition rule; maximize inner spatial class/specimen weighted recall then minimize logloss
classifier: Weighted standardized shrinkage LDA: lambda0.75 diagonal ridge1e-4
validation: 4 outer spatial folds; re-screen all55 within each outer train; repeat association filtering and five-feature selection inside each outer training set; overlap+2pixel buffer purged. The full-data selected panel then receives a clearly labeled conditional spatial assessment with fold-specific refitting.
weights: Equal classes, equal physical specimens within class, equal ROIs within specimen
scope: Spatial performance in existing specimens. GH and ACTH each n1, GnH n3. No new-patient generalization or class significance claim.
